subject: Mutual QBR action & runway — prep and security deliverables
messages:
From: Rebecca Long <rebecca@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep — mutual action items + security evidence

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Acme's execs want a short mutual action plan ahead of the QBR next month. Key asks from my side:

- A one-page mutual action plan (owners + target dates)
- SOC2 evidence map and expected delivery dates
- Any capacity/runway concerns we should flag (e.g., quota, burst limits)

I've attached a starting M-A-P (spreadsheet) and our procurement intake. Can you confirm who at Redwood will own each line and dates so I can share with our VP?

Goal: final MAP by May 10 so our ops/finance teams have time for review.

Rebecca
Rebecca Long
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Analytics

Attachments: QBR_mutual_action_plan_v3.xlsx
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rebecca Long <rebecca@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep — mutual action items + security evidence

Rebecca — thanks, sending a first pass. I've looped in Markus (product) for roadmap/owners and Vivek (infra/ops) for capacity and SOC2 evidence timing. Quick answers up front:

- We can own the MAP owners for feature rollouts (Monica: PM owner), rollout dates look feasible but need one dependent clarifying item from product (see item 3).
- SOC2 artifacts: we can provide the evidence map and a slimset of logs by May 12; full artifacts (policy PDFs, controls attestations) by May 20.
- Capacity: no immediate quota constraints for the QBR window; if Acme opts for heavy embedding re-indexing we may recommend a short burst reservation.

Action: Markus, can you confirm owner/date for the model variant gating item in row 3 of the MAP (the deterministic reranking change)? Also, Vivek — confirm whether we should propose a short Dedicated burst for the indexing job.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

---Original attachment referenced---
Attachments: QBR_mutual_action_plan_v3.xlsx
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rebecca Long <rebecca@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep — mutual action items + security evidence

Thanks for the ping. Quick product notes:

1) Deterministic reranking (MAP row 3) — owner: Markus (product lead). ETA: may cause a 1-week slip vs. current MAP because we need a small perf regression check and a canary rollout. Proposed date: May 18 (canary) -> May 25 (full).
2) Feature gating: we'll provide a config snippet and rollout instructions by May 11.
3) Exec ask: if Acme needs the earlier date, we can prioritize the canary but will need a written sign-off to take on the risk.

Note for Monica: flagging that the MAP currently shows May 13 for this item; recommend we move to May 18 to avoid last-minute regressions.

- Markus
Product Manager, Inference
Redwood Inference

On Thu, 6 May 2027 at 07:08 Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Rebecca — sending a first pass...
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Rebecca Long <rebecca@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 15:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep — mutual action items + security evidence

Looping in a couple tactical notes from GTM/CS perspective:

- Procurement item (procurement@acmeanalytics.com): we'll provide a standard SOW template and the draft commercial terms by May 12; Monica — can you confirm whether Acme prefers net-30 or net-45?
- Pricing: if Acme requests a Dedicated burst for indexing (Vivek to confirm), finance owns the credit/discount ask. Markus — can you estimate the incremental token cost for the indexing job (ballpark hours/GPU-type)?
- QBR runbook: I will own the slide outline — will share a draft by May 9 and request exec confirmation by May 11.

Thanks — let's keep the MAP authoritative for owners/dates.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Growth
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rebecca Long <rebecca@acmeanalytics.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep — mutual action items + security evidence

Team — consolidated next steps and owners below (I updated the attached MAP):

1) MAP row 1 (Intro & success metrics) — Owner: Lauren — deliverable: one-slide metrics definition — Due: 2027-05-09
2) MAP row 2 (SOW + commercial terms) — Owner: Lauren/Finance — deliverable: draft SOW + term preference — Due: 2027-05-12
3) MAP row 3 (Deterministic reranking roll) — Owner: Markus — deliverable: canary rollout plan + risk sign-off — Due: 2027-05-18 (canary)
4) MAP row 4 (SOC2 evidence map) — Owner: Vivek — deliverable: evidence list + slimset of logs — Due: 2027-05-12; full artifacts by 2027-05-20
5) MAP row 5 (Indexing capacity) — Owner: Vivek/Infra — deliverable: recommendation & burst quote — Due: 2027-05-10
6) MAP row 6 (Exec ask on credits/runway) — Owner: Monica (coordinate with Finance) — deliverable: recommended credit/discount ask for QBR — Due: 2027-05-13

Rebecca — can you confirm the May 10/12 deadlines work for your team? I attached the updated MAP and a short SOC2 evidence stub for your procurement.

Thanks all — will follow up with a final MAP and slides.

Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Monica.Patel@redwood.com
